summary: Verification completed. Only VITHIT met the publication gate: it is a European consumer brand, the 100% acquisition by Nichols plc was explicitly completed, and a high-reliability listed-company RNS supports both completion and resulting ownership. All other candidates were rejected because they were pending/announced only, not a control transfer, had a false buyer/control characterization, or lacked a reliable completed-closing source as of 2026-09-05.

approved_deals.direct_owner: VITHIT Limited, wholly owned by Nichols plc
approved_deals.one_line_summary: UK-listed soft drinks group Nichols plc acquired 100% of Irish functional drinks brand VITHIT on 2026-08-10.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: Nichols plc announced that it had acquired 100% of the issued share capital of VITHIT Limited and its subsidiaries for €75.0 million on a debt-free, cash-free basis. The announcement also states that following completion Nichols would retain the Dublin office and management support, indicating VITHIT is now within Nichols plc.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Completed 100% acquisition of a consumer-facing Irish beverage brand, supported by a high-reliability listed-company regulatory announcement with a full publication/completion date.

sources.publisher: London Stock Exchange RNS / Nichols plc
sources.title: Acquisition of VITHIT
sources.summary: Nichols plc announced on 2026-08-10 that it had acquired 100% of the issued share capital of VITHIT Limited and its subsidiaries for €75.0 million, describing VITHIT as a Dublin-founded functional drinks brand with market-leading positions in the UK and Ireland.

rejected_candidates.reason: Rejected: European Commission sources confirm notification and approval of Naspers/Prosus acquiring sole control, but the opened regulator sources do not explicitly confirm that closing/completion occurred. Local media reported the founder's stake sale and post-approval ownership, but no reliability-4/5 completion source from Naspers/Prosus/eMAG or a registry filing was found to support a completed current-owner row as of 2026-09-05.

Rejected: ACCO Brands' 2026-08-14 announcement says it entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Trust and that closing was expected in late Q3 or early Q4 2026 subject to closing conditions, including competition approvals. This is announced/pending, not completed.

Rejected: The Delivery Hero/Uber materials describe a voluntary takeover offer and business combination agreement subject to closing conditions and regulatory approvals, with closing expected later; it is not a completed acquisition as of the verification date.

rejected_candidates.brand: Glovo Spain and other Delivery Hero operations in 14 markets
rejected_candidates.reason: Rejected: The SSW Partners asset sale is expressly conditioned on completion of Uber's offer for Delivery Hero. No completed transfer of the Glovo/14-market operations was confirmed.

Rejected: Orkla announced an agreement to acquire 100% and Dutch ACM cleared acquisition of sole control, but Orkla's M&A table still listed inclusion in financials as TBD and no closing confirmation was found. Also, CCI is primarily a private-label confectionery manufacturer rather than a clear consumer-facing brand/platform for this list.

Rejected: The candidate's buyer/control characterization is wrong. AUTODOC's 2026-08-19 announcement states the founders, via AutoTech GmbH & Co. KG, bought out Apollo-managed funds and again indirectly hold 100% of Autodoc SE; Apollo had held a minority investment since 2024. This is not an Apollo acquisition or majority-stake control change by Apollo.

Rejected: The Greek competition authority approval of Blackstone's acquisition of sole control is a regulatory milestone only. No reliable source confirming transaction closing was found, so the existing pending row should not be converted to completed.

Rejected: Suggested update concerns a pending indirect ownership change tied to Uber's proposed Delivery Hero takeover and a conditional SSW Partners sale. No completed ownership change for Glovo was confirmed.
